item.title: Re: Seeking greenlights for SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
1) You can convince soldiers that you're one of them in a matter of seconds, especially given the situation (WWII soldiers would have welcomed Resistance help, which was a Dutch thing from 1941). However, if this is a "normal" thing, then it's likely that almost no one would consider it more than a show. However, if you want to interact and have a meaningful conversation, you need more time.

There are the questions of why someone would try to interact with the show and how someone who would want to be close to the guns when they appear would manage that.

2) There needs to be an actual story; there has to be a reason for this particular unit defending against those particular airplanes, and why people are allowed to interact with them. Was the unit losing people, and so sees allowing people to join as a necessity? Could it have been a volunteer battery? You just need some sort of story.

3) So what happens when you interact with the unit besides disappearing with it? And if it's happened before, what does The Foundation know? These are going to help sell your idea, so make sure you include them.

+ Reaction (thanks for the crit bdw)

A way it could be more than just another haunted soldier's story? I could involve the sergeant his family. But then it would be another sad story about someone who lost their son/husband in the war and sees it happen every month. Hmmm…..

What if the wife of the sergeant did not care about him. He went to war, she slept with another man, she did not bother to respond to his letters, etc? But now she is forced to see her husband his death every month over and over again. I should probably work that out a bit more. Has something like that been done before?

As for your 2 nitpicks, one I understand, the other one I do not. I should indeed make the time longer. As for your second one, I guess it is my fault not making it clear enough. There are 4 things to it. 3 planes in the air and 1 anti aircraft cannon on the ground. I used the word ´crew´ to describe the persons controlling the cannon. Like I said:

Described in one sentence it is basically: ´A monthly illusion where you follow the story of a crew shooting at three planes and you can interact with it´.

You follow the men on the ground. Not the pilots. The men die to a plane crashing into them. My apologies.

During the 70 seconds prior to the shooting, during preparations, they involve in conversations letting you know more about them. They talk about the war and the sergeant in particular about his family, and how he is hoping to see they are alright. Then they get alarmed by the upcoming planes, and the crew dies to the crash.

70 seconds isn't long enough to have a conversation. Try and time yourself to see how many words you can say out loud in 70 seconds. Not alot.

You can interact with the crew members. There are 2 outcomes:

How does one interact with the crew? They're only extant for 70 seconds before they crash… how would someone get on the plane in that time when its random where they start off? AND they start off in flight. Additionally, If someone did get on the plane, wouldn't they just die with the rest of the crew?

Right now, this isn't a bad idea… but it is thin. What is it you're hoping to turn this into? If its just haunted soldiers in the war… I feel like that's an idea that's been done to death. How could you make this stand out?

Also, you absolutely have to deal with the nitpicks above in the collapsible. These two issues will make it functionally impossible to have long enough interactions with the crew to make this story worthwhile.

item.title: Seeking greenlights for SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: I plan on adding pictures.

Elevator Pitch:

+ Open
- Close

SCP-XXXX is an event that takes place in the Netherlands on every first Monday of a month, at 12:00 CET. The following phases of SCP-XXXX then take place. These are:

1) A siren, measured about 104 decibel, sounds for 90 seconds. This siren sounds within the borders of the Netherlands from an unknown source.

2) During those 90 seconds, three Heinkel He 111 warplanes appear in the air and fly a route of 10 kilometre. The spawn location and route of these planes are random. A Vickers 7.5 tl antiaircraft cannon with crew will also appear about 7 kilometre in on that route. These planes are like an illusion in the air.

3) About 70 seconds in, the planes come into the cannon its range. The crew fires at the planes and hits one of them. The plane crashes into the cannon, making a dust cloud. You are unable to see the cannon and the crew.

4) At the end of the 90 seconds, the cannon, crew and planes disappear.

Described in one sentence it is basically: ´A monthly illusion where you follow the story of a crew shooting at three planes and you can interact with it´.

Central Narrative:
You follow a crew of five soldiers and a sergeant. During the 70 seconds prior to the shooting, during preparations, they involve in conversations letting you know more about them. They talk about the war and the sergeant in particular about his family, and how he is hoping to see they are alright. Then they get alarmed by the upcoming planes, and the crew dies to the crash.

You can interact with the crew members. There are 2 outcomes:
1. You are a civilian, they say you should go home.
2. Or you fool them by pretending to be a soldier, in that case you become part of the play (you start behaving like a soldier, no communication with you is then possible). You disappear just like the crew afterwards.

The people seeing the SCP don't pay attention to it (think it's normal) because of its effects.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The interesting parts where I want to focus on are the story from the crew and sergeant and what happens when you become part of the play.

Additional Notes:
1. I might have to make the time longer.
2. Yes, the siren is an actual thing in the Netherlands. I figured it could be a potential idea for an SCP.
